title: Research deep enough to bet on
description: Answers you can bet on, with a source for every claim, plus market maps and websites turned into spreadsheets. Free to download.
introduction: A search engine gives you ten links. Strawberry opens them, follows the ones behind them, reads the pages that need a login, and keeps a link to every source it used.
That's the difference between a summary you'd forward and research you'd make a decision on.

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Chat assistants summarize what search engines show them. Strawberry goes and reads.

items: It opens pages, follows links, and reads sites that need a login.
It reads many pages at once, so deep research stays quick.
Every claim keeps a link to its source.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

blocks.text: Keep research in the team workspace and nobody starts from zero. The next person picks up where the last one stopped, sources and all.
